object_description: four offset volumes arranged on a common base
design_condition: The four volumes are set on a common base and stepped across the natural height difference, extending the castle park southward while preserving the orchard, historic garden and a permeable landscape connection.

positive.statement: The village-scaled volumetry dialogues with the built and historical context and provides a clear four-volume layout.
The differentiated levels take advantage of the slope and make the landscape more permeable.
The four distinct buildings bring a domestic scale to the different units.
The living units are organized on a human scale and are considered interesting.
The green rooms extending into the building's heart form large landscaped areas with fruit trees.
The northern relationship with the park and castle is of high quality.
The project offers quality relaxation, walking and meeting areas.

negative.statement: The base is difficult to understand at the end of the plot and terminates in a retaining wall.
The southern parking position is problematic in use.
The entrance square faces the parking lot, raising doubts about its quality and appropriation potential.
The four bodies and linear distribution become somewhat rigid and repetitive.
The distribution space is unrelated to collective spaces, making its use unclear.
The proportions of the semi-private spaces raise doubts about their quality and functioning.
The administrative spaces lack a relationship with the entrance and conflict with the principle of supporting the elderly.
The relationship between the different bodies remains poorly developed and is necessary for the use of the institution.
The massive base and separation from the fields are inappropriate to the historic site.
The outdoor car park detracts from the general atmosphere and views of the adjacent fields.
The natural ventilation strategy is ineffective and does not guarantee thermal comfort without technical cooling.
The estimated overall cost is in the upper average, particularly because of the extensive facades and their composition.
